newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ADM raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ADM raised to buy.

text.p: Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Friday she raised her rating on Archer Daniels Midland Co to a buy from a hold.

-- She said ADM President G. Allen Andreas, speaking at a Dain Bosworth conference, told investors that high-fructose corn syrup margins should begin improving in the first quarter of fiscal 1998, primarily due to lower corn costs.
-- In a report, Wittenburg added corn and soybean crops in the Midwest are "looking great to date," adding she expects grain prices to continue to fall as long as crops progress.
-- She added that ADM's relatively new acquisitions, such as in the cocoa business, should also be additive to earnings.
-- Wittenburg said Andreas also told investors that ADM has had discussions with Monsanto Co and others about processing and distribution alliances.
